blurb: Smokin Reel Charters offers guided fishing trips in New Jersey waters targeting species like striped bass, bluefin tuna, and more. Trips range from half day to full day adventures on a 28’ Albemarle boat with twin 325 HP engines. Suitable for anglers of all skill levels, including families and beginners, with gear and guidance provided.
